name: dsh-notifications
description: Approval attention plugin for the dsh web GUI: when an approval / plan review / question is pending (in any session, including subagents), the browser fires audible + visual alert channels (WebAudio chime, tab-title badge, PWA app badge, Approval Hub dock with arrival pulse, optional OS notifications). Also alerts on session completion, job failure, and connection loss/reconnect. Editable settings card on the web settings surface. Pure plugin via the profile patch.

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js && node scripts/smoke.mjs
